checks.name: Cost
checks.question: Is every line of the estimate fairly priced for this district, and is the whole estimate fair?
checks.headline: The quantities fit the size of the work.
limitations: Price of the work: could not check, because the real works of this kind in Uttar Pradesh vary too much in price per metre (the middle 80% runs to +58%): their records miss something that sets the price, such as width, height or wattage.

Not priced here, for want of reliable price data (recorded, so it can be collected): cement (4 recent forms from 4 other agencies; 5 from 3 needed); sand (4 recent forms from 4 other agencies; 5 from 3 needed); stone aggregate (4 recent forms from 4 other agencies; 5 from 3 needed); gsb / wbm / moorum (2 recent forms from 2 other agencies; 5 from 3 needed); skilled labour (4 recent forms from 4 other agencies; 5 from 3 needed); unskilled labour (4 recent forms from 4 other agencies; 5 from 3 needed).
Only 43% of the money is in lines with a fair rate or a known need (at least 60% is needed), so the whole estimate was not judged.
The state's Schedule of Rates is not loaded yet (T096): lines are compared with other agencies' recent rates in the district where there are enough, and quantities with what the size needs.
